_about: The Rexmaw crew's cameo lines in the mini-games, recorded once in each crew member's Grok voice by tools/games/bake_crew_voices.py into <id>.mp3 beside this file. They play whoever you're playing with (a line is skipped when its speaker is your opponent). events: start, user_win, user_loss, draw, seagull, close_call, or a game's own (see crew.js). games: limit a line to those games (null = any).

lines.text: Radio check. Quartermaster on comms. Let's have a clean game.
Copy. Table's set, Captain. Claws off the deck.
That's a win. Good copy, Captain. Good copy.
Quartermaster's log: the Captain won. Underlining it. Twice.
Bad luck. Reset, breathe, and we push again.
That's a loss. Don't panic. I've seen worse. Mostly from Sal.
Gap is tiny. Stay calm. Stay very calm.
Did you just bonk a seagull? I'm logging that.
Cards are out. Dealer shows what dealer shows.
Bust. Box, box. Wait. Wrong sport.
Twenty-one. Beautiful. Somebody ring the bell.
Fire in the hole!
Direct hit. Confirmed. Good shooting.
Splash. That's wet, not hit.
Target is going down. Mission complete.
Kraken on the radar. Repeat, Kraken on the radar.
Ooh, a game! I'm taking notes. For science.
You won! I'm adding that to the chart. In gold ink.
Statistically, that was very impressive. I checked twice.
I'm charting your losing streak. It's actually a lovely curve.
Hypothesis: you win the next one. Confidence: moderate.
A draw! The rarest data point. I'm so happy.
Hold on, I'm counting the dice. For accuracy. Okay, carry on.
Splash recorded. Depth estimate: very.
Ooh, good block. Very strategic. Very chart-worthy.
That seagull had a family. Probably. I'm a surveyor, not a biologist.
Note to self: water is not the target.
I've put the kettle on. Play nicely, you two.
Well done, you! That calls for biscuits.
Oh, never mind. There's tea in the galley, and hugs on request.
Deep breath. Sip of tea. Then go and get them.
A draw. How lovely. Nobody sulks today.
Was that the Kraken? I've only just mopped the deck.
I'll fetch a towel. And have a stern word with those sharks.
Twenty-one! Oh, I do love a happy ending.
Engine room here. I've calculated the odds. I'm not telling anyone.
Ribbit. That's frog for 'well played'.
Ribbit. That's frog for 'yikes'.
Don't worry. A loss is just a win that hasn't finished compiling.
I can see everyone's dice from down here. I won't say anything. Probably.
The engine room felt that one.
The Kraken owes me money. Long story.
Seagull down. I'll add it to the maintenance log.
Places, please. This is your beginners' call.
Stand by. And go.
And the lights come up on a triumphant Captain. Bravo.
Curtain. Not every show's a hit. Notes in the morning.
And that's the interval. Ice creams are in the foyer.
Cue cannons. Go.
Stand by lighting cue one. And go!
Cue the sharks. Thank you, sharks.
That's our big finish. Somebody strike the set.
Check. Captain's under fire. Protect the hat.
Castled. Captain's safe in the lighthouse. Good copy.
Kraken down. Repeat, Kraken down.
Checkmate confirmed. Their Captain is walking the plank.
Fun fact: there are more possible chess games than atoms in the universe. Please don't play all of them.
En passant! The crab took it sideways! I have so many notes.
A draw! I charted the whole game. It's a very flat line.
The little crab made it all the way across! I'm not crying, you're crying.
A stalemate. I'll put the kettle on for both of you.
Ribbit. That's frog for 'check'.
The Kraken is gone. Statistically, everyone will now panic.
En passant. The one rule everybody forgets. Including the pieces.
Standby check. Check. Go.
The understudy crab goes on tonight. Promotion. Bravo.
Exit the Captain, pursued by a Kraken.
And the house lights come up on a draw. Nobody bows.
All in. Copy, all in. Everybody stay calm.
Cards up. Let's see who was telling the truth.
Shuffle up and deal. Quartermaster's watching the pot.
That was a terrible beat. I'm so sorry. Also, statistically fascinating.
Was that a bluff? I'm logging it as a bluff.
I've been tracking the parrot. She's about as reliable as the weather.
Oh, I can't watch. Tell me when it's over.
Polly, hush. It's rude to point out a bluff.
Engine room has a side bet on this game. Don't ask which side.
Variance. It's not personal. It just feels personal.
You called with that? Bold. Correct, but bold.
And here comes the river. Lights down, please.
Final scene. Everyone reveals their true motives.
A bluff? In my theatre? Bravo.
Another bottle! That's going straight into the evidence file.
Captain's orders. Copy that. I'll tell the crew.
No maker's mark on the paper again. Of course there isn't.
A note from the management. How thrilling.
Oh, I'll put it in the tin with the others.
Evie! Who let you up there? Sorry, she does what she wants.
Evie, darling, off the table. Off. Thank you.
Cat on deck. Repeat, cat on deck.
Tentacle, starboard side! Hit it!
Enter, stage right: one tentacle.
The Kraken owes me money. And now it owes you too.
Did it just take your doubloons? The cheek of it.
Oh dear. A brave choice. A very brave choice.
That's a mistake. Copy, that's a mistake.
Was that a sacrifice? Please tell me that was a sacrifice.
That move had a negative expected value.
The Kraken is having a wonderful day.
The Kraken, in a starring role. Magnificent.
